act4/encounters/fight_morvayn.title: Confrontation with Morvayn
act4/encounters/fight_morvayn.body: **Morvayn** raises his staff. The hall tightens your chest — now it is steel.

choices.text: First phase — confrontation!
First phase — confrontation!

act4/encounters/fight_morvayn_2.title: Throne Awakening
act4/encounters/fight_morvayn_2.body: The throne **wakes**. His form swells with bones that were never his.

choices.text: Second phase — throne!
Second phase — throne!

act4/encounters/pact_vigil_skirmish.title: Vigil Skirmish
act4/encounters/pact_vigil_skirmish.body:
From the **shadow** of a fountain, a **Vigil** archer cuts your path. No sermon — only **certainty**.

"**Servant** is not citizen," he says. "It is an open **wound** in the city."

choices.text: Answer the Vigil's steel

onEnterDiaryTexts: A Vigil hunter recognized my step, not my face. To those who swear by the light, the pact smells of betrayal.

act4/late_merchant.title: Throne Merchant
act4/late_merchant.body:
Among **chains** that do not bind, someone unfolds a cloth. Flasks tremble in the hall's cold. The merchant measures you by smell: someone climbing without cutting the shadow at the root.

> Stock **limited**. The throne eats memory — **gold** still buys silence.

choices.text: Buy Red Potion (14 gold) (x2)
Buy Red Potion (14 gold) (x1)
Buy Blue Tonic (18 gold) (x1)
Buy Mead (12 gold) (x1)
Buy Wind-Step Charm (−8 gold)
Vigil field kit (−7 gold)
choices.preview: Supply · Vigil seal (once at this stall)

choices.text: Step away from the merchant

act4/morvayn_interlude.title: False Truce
act4/morvayn_interlude.body:
Morvayn **wavers** — theater, not weakness. The throne breathes through him; the air turns dense, too sweet, like cathedral sickness.

You have one **instant** to decide *how* to carry the next assault: in the **head**, in the **bone**, or in blind haste.

choices.text: Make one last sweep of the hall
Bury the fear in your mind (+Mind, 3 scenes)
diaryTexts: Before the second phase, I sealed the echo like invisible armor and read the hall with calm.

choices.text: Harden the body (+STR, 3 scenes)
diaryTexts: The throne trembles — so do I, but by choice. Each step measures the next blow.

choices.text: Accept the seal's cost and breathe deep (−Mind, +cruel focus)
diaryTexts: Instead of running, I accepted the tremor. Clarity came with pain.

choices.text: Force the second phase now (shortcut without exploring)

act4/morvayn_parley.title: Parley with Morvayn
act4/morvayn_parley.body: "Peace is **silence**," says Morvayn. "Choose the silence you prefer to hear."

choices.text: Refuse the pact and fight
Accept service to the Third Bell
choices.preview: Verbal confrontation with Morvayn; victory leads to pact, failure to combat.
choices.lockedHint: The Third Bell only extends its hand to those the Cult has not yet marked as declared enemies.

choices.text: Try to seal the dungeon (sacrifice)
choices.lockedHint: You need at least 2 measures of faith to risk the seal — conviction drawn tight.

act4/pact/pact_after_mind.title: Domesticated Echo
act4/pact/pact_after_mind.body:
The echo **settles**. It does not vanish — it keeps your name and goes quiet for a while.

For a moment the world turns clean: each step answers because you **allowed** it.

choices.text: Cross the square without faltering

act4/pact/pact_after_mind_fail.title: Echo's Bite
act4/pact/pact_after_mind_fail.body:
The echo **bites**. A spark crosses your thoughts like iron on the tongue.

You still serve — but the price sticks to the roof of your mouth, sweet and wrong.

choices.text: Cross anyway — by force

onEnterDiaryTexts: The echo ran down my throat. Something cracked in my attention — and the Third Bell laughed low.

act4/pact/pact_ascent.title: Pact Ascent
act4/pact/pact_ascent.body:
The **dungeon** stays on your back — damp, stuck to the skin. Underneath, something still **pulls** downward.

A **bell** does not ring. Even so your pulse tries to follow what does not exist.
onEnterDiaryTexts: I accepted the Third Bell. Each step upward sounds like a peal only I hear.
act4/pact/pact_ascent.skillCheckLabel: Contain the Third Bell before the surface

act4/pact/pact_ascent_fail.title: Fractured Echo
act4/pact/pact_ascent_fail.body:
The **Third Bell** hits inside like a hammer on glass.

For a moment you climb with someone else's knees — short breath, mind sparking. The street opens ahead; Morvayn already waits, as if the failure were the invitation.

choices.text: Fail in silence and face Morvayn

onEnterDiaryTexts: I lost the Third Bell's rhythm. I climbed broken — and Morvayn heard the crack.

act4/pact/pact_coda.title: Pact Coda
act4/pact/pact_coda.body:
The hunter falls or flees; the city pretends to sleep. You serve the **Third Bell** as a conduit — the **ring** on your finger is mute to others, deafening to you.

Cold climbs the city's skin. You hear the fourth **promised** strike, never cast.

choices.text: Accept what was written in you

onEnterDiaryTexts: I served the Third Bell. The ring on my finger does not ring — but the world goes quiet when I breathe.

act4/pact/pact_trial_mind.title: Trial of Mind
act4/pact/pact_trial_mind.body:
The market noise folds over itself. You see symbols where you should not — or they were always there, and only now you can read.

To keep from splitting in half, one thing: keep your head as a **chamber** for the sound, not as the bell.
act4/pact/pact_trial_mind.skillCheckLabel: Sustain the Third Bell's echo in your mind

act4/pact/pact_whispers.title: Pact Whispers
act4/pact/pact_whispers.body:
Among **watchmen** who pretend not to see, a voice — not yours — describes what you will do before you think. *"**Serve**."* Not a request. An order.

The **Third Bell** needs no metal; it needs someone who can carry the echo without breaking.

choices.text: Let the whisper finish

onEnterDiaryTexts: In the city, windows close early. Silence here is not peace; it is a queue.

act4/passage_graywind_heights.title: Passage

choices.text: Stop at the threshold — gray armor that did not come from the throne
choices.preview: Verbal confrontation with Kael (draft); failure leads to steel.

choices.text: [↑] Climb to the surface — see how the village and the Heights fared
choices.preview: Chapter 5. Surface and cold; check whether anything changed.

choices.text: [↓] Descend deeper — magma throat at the floor of the axis
choices.preview: Chapter 8. Hostile heat; go to the root.

act4/seal_ending.title: Seal Ending
act4/seal_ending.body:
You seal the **Dungeon of Silence** at a price. Scars on the soul; fragile peace in the stones.

The seal asks for two pulses in a row — first the **mind** enduring the bell bursting inside, then the **body** when the weight falls like stone.
act4/seal_ending.dualAttrSkillCheckLabel: Two beats of the seal — mind and iron

act4/seal_ending_fail.title: Peace Ruptured
act4/seal_ending_fail.body:
Peace **fails** for an instant that is enough. Stones shake, the seal cracks open, and you carry in your chest the scar of what you could not contain.

**Morvayn** smiles like one who already knew: now the fight begins with the world against you.

choices.text: The seal breaks. Fight Morvayn

act4/throne/throne_arcane.title: Runes Beneath the Green Pulse
act4/throne/throne_arcane.body: The runes **bark** instead of shining. If you look away, they rearrange — like fingers in a throat.
act4/throne/throne_arcane.skillCheckLabel: Read the pattern without letting the throne in

act4/throne/throne_arcane_fail.title: Letter That Bites
act4/throne/throne_arcane_fail.body: The line **splits** you in half: too much invitation, not lack of wit. The throne laughs without sound; the echo sits like holy heartburn.

choices.text: Drop your gaze and return to the antechamber
diaryTexts: The rune bit my thought — a hole remained where order should be.

onEnterDiaryTexts: The rune bit into the thought — a hole where order should have been.

act4/throne/throne_arcane_ok.title: Pattern Contained
act4/throne/throne_arcane_ok.body: For a moment the symbol **clicks**. Not loose power — grammar. The throne stops being only fear and becomes a sentence you can refuse out loud.

choices.text: Keep the mental map and return to the antechamber
diaryTexts: I saw the throne's measure — not enough to tame it, enough not to lose myself at once.

onEnterDiaryTexts: I saw the throne's rhythm — too little to tame it, enough not to get lost at once.

act4/throne/throne_chains.title: Living Chains
act4/throne/throne_chains.body:
The chains **want** fingers. They do not only hold the throne — they rehearse your name like a new chain.

Among them, stuck in black resin: a **finger** with a cracked bell-ring and human tooth marks — someone bit the hand that swore.

choices.text: Take a fragment caught in the metal (−1 supply, +2 gold)
choices.lockedHint: You need at least 1 supply to force the fragment without tearing yourself apart.
diaryTexts: I tore a shard from the throne's bone — the metal did not forgive, but the pocket thanked me.

choices.text: Let the drip touch your skin (+1 corruption, −1 faith)
choices.lockedHint: Without faith to spend, the drip finds no payment in you — gather at least 1.
diaryTexts: I tasted the drip: sweet as promise, and promise always charges interest.

choices.text: Pull your hands back and return

diaryTexts: I tore a shard from the throne's bone — the metal did not forgive, but the purse thanked.
I tasted the drip: sweet as a promise — and a promise always collects.

act4/throne/throne_class_blessing.title: Craft in the Hall
act4/throne/throne_class_blessing.body: The hall **recognizes** crafts as tools: it does not judge — it measures what it can ruin with them.

choices.text: Trace a brief sign in the air — contained blessing
diaryTexts: The throne does not accept light — but accepts that I name it without offering it for free.

choices.text: Measure the space with your body — wall posture
diaryTexts: The floor asked for weight; I gave discipline, not theater.

choices.text: Count the echo as incomplete formula
diaryTexts: Every silence has a coefficient — I only wrote down what does not eat me first.

choices.text: Measure the hall as a firing line — long breath
diaryTexts: The throne offers no clean target — but teaches you to wait for the instant when even bones breathe wrong.

choices.text: Return without invoking craft

act4/throne/throne_gate.title: Throne Antechamber
act4/throne/throne_gate.body:
The **Throne of Bones** rises in interlaced ribs; **chains** creak without wind. **Morvayn** stands before the chair — shadow, then a smile without proper lips.

Each trial in the hall spends itself on bone. You can still bargain with the merchant or let steel wait.

choices.text: Hear the necromancer before crossing steel
choices.preview: Words before steel; pact or provocation.

choices.text: Attack at once (without words)
choices.preview: Steel now — or hesitation that becomes talk.

choices.text: Observe the throne: bones, runes, chains
choices.preview: Information and risk of being seen too much.

choices.text: Bargain with the merchant in the chains' shadow
choices.preview: Gold, items, and silence in vials.

choices.text: Arcane inspection — read runes without yielding to the throne
choices.preview: Mind against rune; failure may cost.

choices.text: Nerves test — treacherous floor
choices.preview: Luck and steady legs; the floor slips.

choices.text: Probe chains and drip
choices.preview: Chains and suspect liquid; gold or curse.

choices.text: Craft in the hall: blessing, posture, or formula
choices.preview: Your class opens one ritual path.

choices.text: Return to the Depths Core
choices.preview: You can still postpone the throne; the core waits.

act4/throne/throne_nerves.title: Nerve Trial
act4/throne/throne_nerves.body: The floor invents steps. If you hesitate, the bone underfoot remembers your weight — and collects.
act4/throne/throne_nerves.luckCheckLabel: Keep your hands steady when the floor lies
act4/throne/throne_nerves.skillCheckLabel: Keep your hands steady when the floor betrays

act4/throne/throne_nerves_fail.title: Stumble
act4/throne/throne_nerves_fail.body: The sole **slips** on thick memory. You do not fall — but you pay the scare with breath and sweat.

choices.text: Accept the fright and return to the antechamber
diaryTexts: I stumbled where there was nothing — the throne likes to pretend holes.

onEnterDiaryTexts: I tripped where there was nothing. The throne likes to fake holes.

act4/throne/throne_nerves_ok.title: Steadfastness
act4/throne/throne_nerves_ok.body: Your body **believes** you for once. Not heroism — a minimum deal with the floor.

choices.text: Return to the antechamber
diaryTexts: Fear came — and passed without stealing my name.

act4/throne/throne_observe.title: The Throne
act4/throne/throne_observe.body:
Each bone of the throne has **a name** scraped in — you cannot read them all. One is your **first fear** in small letters.

The chains drip memory too dense. If you stare too long, the throne learns the shape of your fear.

choices.text: Try to read one full name (Mind test)
Intercept the chains' drip (luck)
Return to the moment of decision

act4/throne/throne_observe_luck.title: Chain Drip
act4/throne/throne_observe_luck.body: The drop **lingers** in the air. Miss the timing and it does not only wet the hand — it stains the rest of the day.
act4/throne/throne_observe_luck.luckCheckLabel: Catch a drop without being marked

act4/throne/throne_observe_luck_fail.title: Betrayed Drop
act4/throne/throne_observe_luck_fail.body: The drop **falls** where it should not — stains the sleeve, steals heat, laughs without teeth.

choices.text: Shake your hand and keep observing
Return to the moment of decision

act4/throne/throne_observe_luck_ok.title: Captured Drop
act4/throne/throne_observe_luck_ok.body: At the right instant, **memory** hesitates and you catch the drop. The throne has not noticed yet.

choices.text: Keep observing the throne
diaryTexts: The drop solidified between my fingers — small coin of ice and luck.

choices.text: Return to the moment of decision

diaryTexts: The drop solidified between my fingers — small ice, living luck.

act4/throne/throne_observe_mind.title: Scraped Names
act4/throne/throne_observe_mind.body: The names **murmur** when you should not be listening. Read aloud and the bone answers with yours.
act4/throne/throne_observe_mind.skillCheckLabel: Decipher a name without the throne hearing

act4/throne/throne_observe_mind_fail.title: Trapped Letter
act4/throne/throne_observe_mind_fail.body: The letter **escapes** and leaves a buzz where sense should be. The throne likes holes — you just paid for one.

choices.text: Give up the reading and keep observing
Return to the moment of decision

act4/throne/throne_observe_mind_ok.title: Silence Read
act4/throne/throne_observe_mind_ok.body: You find a **line** that is not yours — and even so it aligns your fear like a ruler.

choices.text: Keep observing the throne
diaryTexts: One name yielded — not mine, but one that serves as crooked mirror.

choices.text: Return to the moment of decision

act4/throne/throne_sweep.title: Last Sweep
act4/throne/throne_sweep.body: Before the throne closes the account, you can still treat the hall like a table: measurements, bets, honest mistakes.

choices.text: Follow a fissure behind the throne (explore in silence)
Catalog bones and shadows (Mind test)
Release a forbidden syllable into the void (luck)
Give the bone no more time — to the second phase

act4/throne/throne_sweep_cat_fail.title: Count That Flees
act4/throne/throne_sweep_cat_fail.body: The bone **multiplies** when you are not looking. Not a trick — a cruel lesson.

choices.text: Continue the sweep of the hall
To the second phase — throne!

onEnterDiaryTexts: I lost the count; the throne added a line to my fear.

act4/throne/throne_sweep_cat_ok.title: Bone Map
act4/throne/throne_sweep_cat_ok.body: The number **closes** a circle: you stop being a visitor and become a measure inside the room.

choices.text: Continue the sweep of the hall
To the second phase — throne!

onEnterDiaryTexts: I counted until the hall felt small. Space lies when you know where to step.

act4/throne/throne_sweep_catalog.title: Merciless Inventory
act4/throne/throne_sweep_catalog.body: Each rib is an **argument**. Convince yourself too much and the throne adds another line on its side.
act4/throne/throne_sweep_catalog.skillCheckLabel: Count bones without losing yourself in the number

act4/throne/throne_sweep_hidden_treasure.title: Treasure Buried in Bone
act4/throne/throne_sweep_hidden_treasure.body:
Among petrified ribs, you find a **black nodule** locked in old iron. Touch it and the hall changes weight; something in you learns a new rhythm.

It is not gold. It is a **fragment of will** torn from the throne.

choices.text: Keep the fragment and return to the hall

onEnterDiaryTexts: In a hidden cut of the throne, I found a living fragment — it pulses like sharp memory.

act4/throne/throne_sweep_word.title: Syllable in the Void
act4/throne/throne_sweep_word.body: There are words the air **refuses**. Hit the timing and silence pays; fail and the hall collects on the body.
act4/throne/throne_sweep_word.luckCheckLabel: Release the word without being overheard

act4/throne/throne_sweep_word_fail.title: Word That Bites
act4/throne/throne_sweep_word_fail.body: The vacuum **does not forgive** poorly calibrated daring. You pay with body and purse.

choices.text: Continue the sweep of the hall
To the second phase — throne!

onEnterDiaryTexts: The word came back like a whip — stole breath and supplies.

act4/throne/throne_sweep_word_ok.title: Subtracted Echo
act4/throne/throne_sweep_word_ok.body: For a moment the hall **forgets** you. That is enough: not being the throne's matter.

choices.text: Continue the sweep of the hall
To the second phase — throne!

onEnterDiaryTexts: The syllable fell clean — the vacuum accepted the payment.

act4/victory_peace.title: Victory in Silence
act4/victory_peace.body:
The **crack** under the crown sounds like a close, not a crowning — a door that yields when no one left is pushing from the other side.

The green pulse melts into silence; the throne, for an instant furniture, then stone again. Thin **victory**: you stayed on your feet.

choices.text: Gather what remains — listen to the throne
